recognize_zh: 低倍下大片凝固性壞死，細胞輪廓模糊呈鬼影狀並夾雜核碎片，左下有一條管壁增厚、管腔含纖維素的血管；廣泛壞死是結外 NK/T 細胞淋巴瘤常見的表現，但本圖本身無法確立診斷。
features: Extensive geographic coagulative necrosis with ghost cell outlines and eosinophilic debris
Scattered karyorrhectic nuclear dust and few viable-appearing small dark nuclei
Small vessel with thickened wall and fibrinoid/fibrin-filled lumen at lower left
Slightly more cellular band of residual lymphoid cells at right edge
No viable large atypical cells assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power section shows extensive geographic coagulative necrosis composed of ghost cell outlines, eosinophilic debris, and scattered karyorrhectic nuclear fragments. A small vessel with a thickened wall and fibrin-containing lumen is present at the lower left, and a thin rim of residual viable lymphoid cells is seen at the right. Viable tumor cells are not evaluable in this field, so the image alone is not diagnostic. In a nasal/upper aerodigestive tract biopsy, such zonal necrosis with vascular injury is characteristic of extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type, and additional sampling of viable tissue with CD3, CD56, cytotoxic markers, and EBER ISH is required.

ddx.vs: GPA necrosis is basophilic 'dirty' geographic necrosis rimmed by palisading histiocytes and giant cells, without EBER-positive atypical lymphoid cells.
Fungal infection shows angioinvasive hyphae on H&E or GMS/PAS stains in the necrotic tissue.
Viable tumor at the edge shows cohesive keratin-positive cells or a different lymphoma immunophenotype, and EBER is negative.
